title: Namaskar, Piece by Piece
label: ch:first-greeting-script
canDo: I can hear and say namaskār, move हो from tracing through dictation, and read नमस्कार by assembling only signs I have already practised.

payoff.summary: Read नमस्कार and copy it only after hearing its meaning, writing हो from memory and sound, and tracing every load-bearing sign in its own short lesson.
payoff.note: The chapter reaches the twelve-atom ceiling exactly without combining signs or asking for whole-word decoding before the one-sign lessons.
